notes.title: The Tram Log #1 - Mimesis
notes.notes: [p]Hey Survivors![/p][p] [/p][p]Here's some updates on what we've been doing, and we are always open for new conversations if you are curious.[/p][p] [/p][p]First up:[/p][p]An update on [b]Mimesis[/b] — it's learning, adapting, and getting better at fooling humans.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Remember that chill down your spine when you turned around in a dark hallway…?[/p][p]And your squad suddenly becomes a quintet? Yeah, Mimesis was definitely one of the most fun parts, don't you agree?[/p][p][/p][p]Still, many were mentioning how Mimesis sometimes attacked way too quick, leaving no time for suspicion, or it was too easy to spot fake due to obvious usage of voice lines.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s why improving Mimesis is our top priority.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/5b217b74cac881d5ce7cbe11640b105a6f6ce4d0.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]              <Gather up — it’s training time!>[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Just like people react differently in the same situation, Mimesis will also be updated to respond with a wider range of behaviors depending on what's happening.[/p][p] [/p][p]We’re also improving how Mimesis blends in with the group, uses items, and mimics voice chat — so expect more surprising and hilarious encounters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/808aa2db20014e5faa03d8b66f2d508d10eff64c.gif"][/img]                           <[i]Until the day Mimesis finally beats a human at rock-paper-scissors>[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Stay tuned — and if you’ve got thoughts, hit us up on[url="https://discord.gg/6WJvq36rab"] Discord.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’re listening.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827200/MIMESIS/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

a) The Game includes artificial intelligence (“AI”) features that simulate in-game characters, including the main monster “Mimesis.” When you play the Game, you will interact with these AI-powered characters.
These AI features are driven by pre-trained models that generate fixed, predefined responses based on Environmental Data collected during your gameplay. Environmental Data refers to contextual information such as your character’s in-game location, triggered events, sensor readings, and the status of nearby objects. The AI does not update itself, evolve, or learn in real time based on your interactions. Users must not interpret AI behavior as reflective of real-world facts or opinions, nor attribute intent, judgment, or agency to the AI or its creators. notes.title: MIMESIS Microphone Setup Guide
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Survivor. [/p][p] [/p][p]To enjoy MIMESIS, you need a microphone connected to your PC. [/p][p]Here are the instructions to help you prepare for the game.[/p][p] [/p][p]First, prepare the microphone and connect it to your PC.[/p][h3]For best experience, it is [b]HIGHLY RECOMMENDED[/b] to use directly connected microphone and without sound altering software, a separate audio interface[/h3][p](The connection method may vary depending on the microphone model and hardware environment, so please refer to the manufacturer’s instructions for your device.)[/p][p]For Bluetooth devices, connect to the PC’s Bluetooth according to the manufacturer’s connection guide.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]First thing to check:[/b][/h3][p]Check if the microphone is connected to the PC. [/p][p]For Windows 10, go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and ensure 'Allow apps to access the microphone.' [/p][p]For Windows 11, go to Privacy & security > Microphone and make sure 'Microphone access' is turned 'On.' Also, verify that the microphone permissions are granted for the game.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/turn-on-app-permissions-for-your-microphone-in-windows-94991183-f69d-b4cf-4679-c98ca45f577a"]Microsoft Support[/url][/p][p] [/p][h2]Windows 11:[/h2][p]Go to Start > Settings > System > Sound[/p][p]Scroll down to the input section and ensure that the microphone you prepared is set as the input device.[/p][p]Especially if you have multiple microphone devices like a webcam, make sure the desired device is selected.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/2267e4565e8e65f844a7707b0320032289f02acf.png"][/img][/p][p]On some versions, you can click on your desired microphone for more specific settings. [/p][p]Click the microphone test button at the bottom, and check it’s working. [/p][p] [/p][h2]Windows 10:[/h2][p]Go to Windows Settings > System > Sound tab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/5befd63948d2cd335659cf5fb26690368b8e3923.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/19cc9eff3c6d17d13b9eb4eb04730ffb3b434f02.png"][/img][/p][p]Check if the desired microphone is selected. If the device you want to use is not selected, click the drop down or list and pick your desired mic.[/p][p]To check if the device is working properly, talk into the microphone. Make sure you see the indicator bar on the bottom.[/p][p] [/p][p]Make sure you're able to voice chat with your teammates after starting the game. [/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you. [/p]

notes.title: FAQ for Steam Next Fest (known issues)
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/f4c1253377aa1d9348f32bd4402604a93a1c1ad3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, survivors.     [/p][p][/p][p]MIMESIS is here with you at Steam Next Fest, which is just around the corner.   [/p][p]This is all thanks to your interest and encouragement.     [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, we'd like to share with you the issues we've identified through Survivor testing and more, so that you can take them into account when playing the game.   [/p][p]We also ask for your patience and understanding for any inconveniences you may encounter while playing. [/p][p]MIMESIS is a game that is still in development, and we hope that your interest and understanding will make it even more fun.   [/p][p][b]You, the survivors, are the ones who make MIMESIS what it is.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Accessing and Playing the Game    [/h2][p]There are times when you may not be able to access a host's room with the error 30000002 (Failed to enter the tram).   [/p][p]In this case, try the following method   [/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]The host waits in the created room (without closing the client)   [/p][/*][*][p]Team members wait on the title screen (without closing the client).   [/p][/*][*][p]After 3-5 minutes, the host tries to invite the team members back in.   [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Best of all, on the first launch, the team members wait on the title screen until the host (the user who created the room) finishes loading the game, arrives at the service station, and invites the other team members.  [/p][p][/p][p]If you join the room after the tram has left the service station, you will have to wait for the other team members to return to the service station.  [/p][p]If possible, you should wait until all team members who want to play the game have arrived at the service station before starting the tram, so that everyone can enjoy the game.     [/p][p][/p][h2]Game specifications and performance   [/h2][p]If you're experiencing performance issues when playing the game in “fullscreen windowed” mode or “windowed” mode, playing in “fullscreen” will help.   [/p][p][/p][p]If you're playing on lower specs, turning off the Steam Overlay may help improve performance.  [/p][p]However, in this case, we recommend that you invite yourself to the host's room as a team member rather than the host.     [/p][p][/p][h2]Connection Region    [/h2][p]Depending on the region and country you're connecting from, you may not be able to play Steam games smoothly.   [/p][p]In this case, there's nothing we can officially do to help.   [/p][p]We ask that you use a VPN, accelerator, or other method that works for you.   [/p][p]Sometimes programs like AdGuard can cause access issues. You may want to check if you have these programs enabled.   [/p][p][/p][h2]Forwarding log files  [/h2][p]If you experience any other issues, it would be very helpful if you could send us the log files with a brief description of the situation.   [/p][p]2 log files to forward: [b]Player.log, Player-prev.log[/b]  [/p][p]Email to cs@relugames.com  or You can use the bug-reports channel in [url="https://discord.gg/6WJvq36rab"]Discord [/url]too. [/p][p]File location: Win + R and enter %USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\relugames\\MIMESIS Demo  [/p]

notes.title: A basic guide for survivors
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44894022/f7e8ce8c8ea8f4af2d58bb15375823c11fc40dc1.png[/img]

Hello. Survivors.

Welcome aboard the tram, where you've taken refuge from the insane rain - and from the family, friends, and colleagues you once knew.

From now on, I will give you seven essential guidelines for boarding and surviving on this tram.

[h2][b]1. Before Departure [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/12d63e891b8bc1a6770ae51db9358aba6de3d9d1.png[/img]
When the game begins, you will join other survivors at the service station.

If you need any items before boarding, we recommend purchasing them in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/6536e2a098e6474eb2c59aa4431ff029c4c59983.png[/img]
※ Please note that item prices are subject to change without notice, so make sure to check the daily rates.

[h2][b]2. Tram Departure [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/133f8cb1e20c2727377f434ebfade8dd8f47b504.png[/img]
Once you're ready,
please press and hold the lever inside the tram (HOLD E) to depart.

[h2][b]3. Destination Selection[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/74aaed2dc52767cf7c9f0c69bd257f91dfea8a7e.png[/img]
Once the tram departs, you will need to choose your destination.
After selecting your desired destination, pull the lever again to arrive at that location.

[b][h2]4. Exploration [/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/b09632fef42c867534b07c69582517e675dc6334.png[/img]
Upon arriving at your destination, please explore the abandoned area and gather resources.
※ However, your survival is the top priority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/458eb7dca7b43770ba1da286eb57c79b0305f9f9.png[/img]
You can drop collected resources onto the tram floor using the G key.
Even after the tram departs, the resources will be preserved and safely transported to the destination - as long as all passengers do not die.

[b][h2]5. Service Time Information [/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/ad8b01bd7be4d65b12e6a48c311813b3efc9c09a.png[/img]
At midnight, the tram will depart automatically.
However, please remember that you can manually operate the lever to depart at any time before midnight.
※ The timing of departure is a strategic decision for survival. Choose wisely.

[b][h2]6. Service Station Arrival[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/5e1422f8b813f777913a19a2c90e130ccbaddaa3.png[/img]
After three days, the tram will arrive at the next service station.
Please sell the resources you’ve collected to repair the tram.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/4057759a78ff1c586d6595b6d271b1339c6a21f9.png[/img]
Additionally, shower facilities are provided free of charge and are available for unlimited use.

[h2][b]7. Departure Again[/b][/h2]

Whether the repairs are complete or not, the tram must depart.

Did you leave without fully repairing the tram?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894022/dbf0f3797ae480fbd21669494a480c5e1a8b2821.png[/img]
Then I will wait for the next group of survivors.

Then, I wish you all a safe survival
and hope to see you again at the next maintenance station.
Stay safe out there.

Hello Survivors,

Thank you for the incredible interest and participation in MIMESIS Survivor Test: DAY 1.

We have completed the selection of Survivor testers and have sent out emails containing Steam keys and testing instructions to those selected.

Please check the inbox of the email address you provided when signing up for testing. Note that the message may have been sorted into your spam or junk folder, so please be sure to check there as well.

To those who were unfortunately not selected, we kindly ask for your understanding—we are working to prepare another opportunity for you to experience MIMESIS as soon as possible.
